 Jio launches industry-first 3-year plan at ₹10,000
 The plan ensures unlimited 5G data, unlimited voice calling, 2.5 GB high-speed data per day and 100 SMS per day
 By Vallari Sanzgiri 
 Updated - November 06, 2026 at 09:47 PM. 
 | 
 Mumbai
 × Share
 WhatsApp X Facebook LinkedIn Messenger Reddit Mail https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/info-tech/jio-launches-industry-first-3-year-plan-at-10000/article71675310.ece Copy 
 Reliance Jio’s three-year plan promises uninterrupted connectivity, entertainment, productivity tools and cloud storage benefits for a full three years
 | Photo Credit:
 NAGARA GOPAL
 Reliance Jio will offer an all-new plan priced at ₹10,000, offering customers unlimited digital experiences for three years starting from November 7 across MyJio, Jio.com, Jio stores, retail outlets and other Jio recharge channels.
 The offering promises uninterrupted connectivity, entertainment, productivity tools and cloud storage benefits for three years with a single recharge on a one-time payment of ₹10,000.
 The plan ensures unlimited 5G data, unlimited voice calling, 2.5 GB high-speed data per day and 100 SMS per day. In addition to connectivity benefits, subscribers will receive a range of digital services, including JioHotstar Mobile + Hollywood access, yearly subscription of Canva Pro Lite, JioAICloud with 50 GB of complimentary cloud storage for secure storage and access to files, photos and documents.
 The announcement comes just as Bharti Airtel announces the revival of its ₹299 entry plan. According to experts, the telecom industry has observed greater market competition, hinting at a departure from an assumed dupolistic market.
